examples.en: This task needs a lot of concentration.
examples.uz: Bu vazifa koʻp diqqat jamlashni talab qiladi.

examples.en: Concentration goes first when people are tired, and mistakes follow.
examples.uz: Odamlar charchaganda birinchi boʻlib diqqat yoʻqoladi, keyin xatolar keladi.

examples.en: It was dishonest of him.
examples.uz: Bu uning tomonidan insofsizlik edi.

examples.en: It wasn't dishonest exactly, but it wasn't honest either.
examples.uz: Bu aynan insofsizlik emasdi, lekin halollik ham emasdi.

examples.en: My family is my priority.
examples.uz: Oilam men uchun ustuvor.

examples.en: When everything is a priority, nothing is.
examples.uz: Hamma narsa ustuvor boʻlsa, hech narsa ustuvor emas.

examples.en: It was cold, yet sunny.
examples.uz: Havo sovuq, ammo quyoshli edi.

examples.en: The evidence was clear, yet nothing at all was done.
examples.uz: Dalillar aniq edi, ammo umuman hech narsa qilinmadi.

examples.en: Sales are projected to rise.
examples.uz: Sotuv oʻsishi bashorat qilinmoqda.

examples.en: Costs are projected to rise again in the second half of the year.
examples.uz: Xarajatlar yilning ikkinchi yarmida yana oshishi bashorat qilinmoqda.

examples.en: What's the catch?
examples.uz: Yashirin sharti nima?

examples.en: The offer sounded perfect, which is how we knew there was a catch.
examples.uz: Taklif mukammal eshitilardi, shundan yashirin shart borligini bildik.

examples.en: My parents don't approve of my plan.
examples.uz: Ota-onam rejamni maʼqullashmaydi.

examples.en: The budget was approved by people who had not read it.
examples.uz: Byudjetni uni oʻqimagan odamlar maʼqullashdi.

examples.en: A mysterious man called me.
examples.uz: Menga sirli bir odam qoʻngʻiroq qildi.

examples.en: There's nothing mysterious about it once you see who benefits.
examples.uz: Kim foyda koʻrishini koʻrsangiz, bunda hech qanday sirlilik qolmaydi.

examples.en: What a strange combination of colours!
examples.uz: Qanday gʻalati ranglar uygʻunligi!

examples.en: It was a combination of bad luck and worse planning.
examples.uz: Bu omadsizlik va undan ham yomonroq rejalashtirishning birikmasi edi.

examples.en: There's a pile of books on the desk.
examples.uz: Stolda kitoblar uyumi bor.

examples.en: Work had piled up while everyone waited for a decision.
examples.uz: Hamma qaror kutib turganda ish uyulib qoldi.

examples.en: The concept is easy to understand.
examples.uz: Tushunchani anglash oson.

examples.en: The concept is simple; everything after it is not.
examples.uz: Tushuncha oddiy; undan keyingi hamma narsa esa yoʻq.

examples.en: The rules are too complicated.
examples.uz: Qoidalar juda murakkab.

examples.en: It's complicated in the way that things are when someone benefits.
examples.uz: Bu kimdir foyda koʻrganda narsalar murakkab boʻladigan tarzda murakkab.

examples.en: Please accept my sincere apologies.
examples.uz: Iltimos, samimiy uzrimni qabul qiling.

examples.en: The apology sounded sincere and changed nothing.
examples.uz: Uzr samimiy eshitildi va hech narsani oʻzgartirmadi.

examples.en: For instance, you can learn ten words a day.
examples.uz: Misol uchun, kuniga oʻnta soʻz oʻrganishingiz mumkin.

examples.en: In this instance the rule was applied and in others it wasn't.
examples.uz: Bu holatda qoida qoʻllandi, boshqalarida esa yoʻq.

examples.en: Please inform us of any changes.
examples.uz: Iltimos, har qanday oʻzgarish haqida bizni xabardor qiling.

examples.en: Staff were informed by email three minutes before the press.
examples.uz: Xodimlar matbuotdan uch daqiqa oldin elektron xat orqali xabardor qilindi.

examples.en: Give me a detailed plan.
examples.uz: Menga batafsil reja bering.

examples.en: A detailed answer would have taken five minutes to write.
examples.uz: Batafsil javob yozishga besh daqiqa ketardi.

examples.en: The job has good prospects.
examples.uz: Ishning istiqboli yaxshi.

examples.en: The prospect of another year like this one worries everybody.
examples.uz: Yana shunday bir yil istiqboli hammani xavotirga soladi.

examples.en: She got a grant to study abroad.
examples.uz: U chet elda oʻqish uchun grant oldi.

examples.en: Permission was granted after the work had already been done.
examples.uz: Ruxsat ish allaqachon bajarilganidan keyin berildi.

examples.en: There is a new scheme to help students.
examples.uz: Talabalarga yordam berish boʻyicha yangi dastur bor.

examples.en: The scheme helped very few of the people it was designed for.
examples.uz: Dastur oʻzi moʻljallangan odamlarning juda kamiga yordam berdi.

examples.en: The sun emerged from behind the clouds.
examples.uz: Quyosh bulutlar ortidan chiqdi.

examples.en: It emerged later that two people had raised the same concern.
examples.uz: Keyinchalik ikki kishi xuddi shu xavotirni bildirgani maʼlum boʻldi.

examples.en: They constructed a new bridge.
examples.uz: Ular yangi koʻprik qurishdi.

examples.en: The argument is carefully constructed and rests on nothing.
examples.uz: Dalil puxta qurilgan va hech narsaga tayanmaydi.

examples.en: Wash your hands to kill bacteria.
examples.uz: Bakteriyalarni yoʻqotish uchun qoʻlingizni yuving.

examples.en: The bacteria had been there all along and nobody had tested.
examples.uz: Bakteriyalar boshidan oʻsha yerda edi va hech kim tekshirmagandi.

examples.en: I reserved a table for four.
examples.uz: Men toʻrt kishiga stol band qildim.

examples.en: The reserves had been spent before anyone noticed they were gone.
examples.uz: Zaxiralar ular tugaganini kimdir sezgunicha sarflab boʻlingandi.

examples.en: He sold ten dollars' worth of fruit.
examples.uz: U oʻn dollarlik meva sotdi.

examples.en: They got a month's worth of work out of a week's budget.
examples.uz: Ular bir haftalik byudjetdan bir oylik ish chiqarishdi.

examples.en: We need to evaluate the results.
examples.uz: Biz natijalarni baholashimiz kerak.

examples.en: Nobody had evaluated whether the previous change had worked.
examples.uz: Oldingi oʻzgarish ish berganmi-yoʻqmi, hech kim baholamagandi.

examples.en: The water is shallow here.
examples.uz: Bu yerda suv sayoz.

examples.en: The analysis is shallow and the conclusions are confident.
examples.uz: Tahlil sayoz va xulosalar ishonch bilan aytilgan.

examples.en: The road goes downwards to the river.
examples.uz: Yoʻl daryo tomon pastga tushadi.

examples.en: The figures have been revised downwards three times.
examples.uz: Raqamlar uch marta pastga qarab qayta koʻrib chiqildi.

examples.en: The aircraft landed safely.
examples.uz: Havo kemasi omon-eson qoʻndi.

examples.en: The aircraft had been grounded for a fault nobody could reproduce.
examples.uz: Havo kemasi hech kim takrorlay olmagan nosozlik tufayli uchishdan toʻxtatilgandi.

examples.en: I begged him to stay.
examples.uz: Men unga qolishini yolvordim.

examples.en: They'd begged for the repairs for years before the ceiling fell in.
examples.uz: Shift qulagunicha ular yillab taʼmir uchun yolvorishgandi.

examples.en: They speak a regional dialect.
examples.uz: Ular mintaqaviy shevada gapiradi.

examples.en: Regional offices were given targets set without consulting them.
examples.uz: Mintaqaviy ofislarga ular bilan maslahatlashmay belgilangan mezonlar berildi.

examples.en: He is studying psychology.
examples.uz: U psixologiyani oʻqiyapti.

examples.en: The psychology of it matters more than the economics.
examples.uz: Buning psixologiyasi iqtisoddan muhimroq.

examples.en: Did anyone witness the accident?
examples.uz: Baxtsiz hodisaga kimdir guvoh boʻlganmi?

examples.en: Two witnesses gave accounts that cannot both be true.
examples.uz: Ikki guvoh ikkalasi ham rost boʻla olmaydigan bayonot berdi.

examples.en: Temperatures hit a new low.
examples.uz: Harorat yangi eng past nuqtaga tushdi.

examples.en: Morale has reached a low that nobody is willing to measure.
examples.uz: Ruhiy holat hech kim oʻlchashni istamaydigan past nuqtaga yetdi.

examples.en: The new law favours small businesses.
examples.uz: Yangi qonun kichik bizneslarni afzal koʻradi.

examples.en: The rules favour whoever can afford to wait.
examples.uz: Qoidalar kutishga qurbi yetadiganlar foydasiga ishlaydi.

examples.en: I met a fellow student in the library.
examples.uz: Men kutubxonada hamkurs talabani uchratdim.

examples.en: A fellow passenger explained what the announcement had meant.
examples.uz: Hamroh yoʻlovchi eʼlon nimani anglatganini tushuntirdi.

examples.en: My grandmother told us old tales.
examples.uz: Buvim bizga qadimgi ertaklar aytardi.

examples.en: It's a cautionary tale that everybody repeats and nobody heeds.
examples.uz: Bu hamma takrorlaydigan va hech kim quloq solmaydigan ibratli hikoya.

examples.en: I can't figure out this problem.
examples.uz: Men bu masalani tushunib yeta olmayapman.

examples.en: It took us a month to figure out what had actually gone wrong.
examples.uz: Aslida nima notoʻgʻri ketganini tushunib yetishimizga bir oy ketdi.

examples.en: The house was in flames.
examples.uz: Uy alanga ichida edi.

examples.en: The row has been fanned into flames by people with nothing to lose.
examples.uz: Janjalni yoʻqotadigan hech narsasi boʻlmaganlar alangalatib yuborishdi.

examples.en: He was unconscious for two hours.
examples.uz: U ikki soat hushsiz yotdi.

examples.en: There's an unconscious bias in how the cases are sorted.
examples.uz: Ishlar saralanishida ongsiz tarzdagi yon bosish bor.

examples.en: He was barred from the club.
examples.uz: U klubga kiritilmadi.

examples.en: Journalists were barred from a meeting that was supposed to be public.
examples.uz: Jurnalistlar ochiq boʻlishi kerak boʻlgan yigʻilishga kiritilmadi.

examples.en: To some extent, I agree.
examples.uz: Maʼlum darajada men roziman.

examples.en: The extent of the damage only became clear in the spring.
examples.uz: Zararning koʻlami faqat bahorda ayon boʻldi.

examples.en: She acknowledged her mistake.
examples.uz: U xatosini tan oldi.

examples.en: They acknowledged the problem without accepting responsibility for it.
examples.uz: Ular muammoni tan olishdi, lekin uning uchun javobgarlikni qabul qilishmadi.

examples.en: Don't be so impatient!
examples.uz: Bunchalik sabrsiz boʻlmang!

examples.en: People are getting impatient, and they have every right to be.
examples.uz: Odamlar sabri tugayapti va ularning bunga toʻliq haqqi bor.

examples.en: The item is out of stock.
examples.uz: Mahsulot zaxirada yoʻq.

examples.en: The item had been out of stock for four months.
examples.uz: Mahsulot toʻrt oydan beri zaxirada yoʻq edi.

examples.en: We need a new approach.
examples.uz: Bizga yangi yondashuv kerak.

examples.en: A different approach was suggested and dismissed in two minutes.
examples.uz: Boshqacha yondashuv taklif qilindi va ikki daqiqada rad etildi.

examples.en: Do you have any proof?
examples.uz: Sizda biror isbot bormi?

examples.en: There's proof of what happened and no appetite to look at it.
examples.uz: Nima boʻlganining isboti bor va unga qarashga ishtiyoq yoʻq.

examples.en: The teacher praised my work.
examples.uz: Oʻqituvchi ishimni maqtadi.

examples.en: The praise went to the person who presented, not the one who did it.
examples.uz: Maqtov ishni bajargan odamga emas, taqdim qilgan odamga tegdi.

examples.en: Prices are subject to change.
examples.uz: Narxlar oʻzgarishi mumkin.

examples.en: The figures are subject to revision, which they always are.
examples.uz: Raqamlar qayta koʻrib chiqilishi mumkin, ular doim shunday.

examples.en: The success was largely due to luck.
examples.uz: Muvaffaqiyat asosan omad tufayli boʻldi.

examples.en: The problem is largely of our own making.
examples.uz: Muammo asosan oʻzimiz keltirib chiqargan muammo.

examples.en: I had a nightmare last night.
examples.uz: Kecha kechasi dahshatli tush koʻrdim.

examples.en: The paperwork alone was a nightmare that took six months.
examples.uz: Faqat qogʻozbozlikning oʻzi olti oy davom etgan dahshat boʻldi.

examples.en: It took me a year to adapt to the new city.
examples.uz: Yangi shaharga moslashishim uchun bir yil kerak boʻldi.

examples.en: Those who adapted quickly did better than those who were right.
examples.uz: Tez moslashganlar haq boʻlganlardan koʻra yaxshiroq natijaga erishdi.

examples.en: Put the pictures in the right sequence.
examples.uz: Suratlarni toʻgʻri ketma-ketlikda joylashtiring.

examples.en: The sequence of events in the report is simply wrong.
examples.uz: Hisobotdagi voqealar ketma-ketligi shunchaki notoʻgʻri.

examples.en: He is the chief of police.
examples.uz: U politsiya boshligʻi.

examples.en: The chief difficulty is that nobody owns the decision.
examples.uz: Bosh qiyinchilik shundaki, qarorga hech kim egalik qilmaydi.

examples.en: Nothing satisfies him.
examples.uz: Uni hech narsa qoniqtirmaydi.

examples.en: The answer satisfies the form and not the question.
examples.uz: Javob blankni qoniqtiradi, savolni esa yoʻq.

examples.en: He works for a law firm.
examples.uz: U yuridik firmada ishlaydi.

examples.en: The firm has been sold twice and still carries the founder's name.
examples.uz: Firma ikki marta sotilgan va hamon asoschisining nomini saqlaydi.

examples.en: The machine isn't functioning properly.
examples.uz: Mashina tuzukroq ishlamayapti.

examples.en: The department functions despite the structure, not because of it.
examples.uz: Boʻlim tuzilma tufayli emas, unga qaramay ishlaydi.

examples.en: The actual price was much higher.
examples.uz: Haqiqiy narx ancha yuqori edi.

examples.en: The actual cost turned out to be nearly double the estimate.
examples.uz: Amaldagi xarajat hisob-kitobdan deyarli ikki baravar koʻp chiqdi.

examples.en: At the close of the meeting, we voted.
examples.uz: Yigʻilish yakunida biz ovoz berdik.

examples.en: At the close of the year nothing had been resolved.
examples.uz: Yil yakunida hech narsa hal qilinmagandi.

examples.en: The new park transformed the area.
examples.uz: Yangi bogʻ hududni tubdan oʻzgartirdi.

examples.en: One honest meeting transformed how the team worked.
examples.uz: Bitta samimiy yigʻilish jamoaning ishlash tarzini tubdan oʻzgartirdi.

examples.en: She has good vision.
examples.uz: Uning koʻrish qobiliyati yaxshi.

examples.en: What's missing is any vision of where this is going.
examples.uz: Yetishmayotgani — bu qayoqqa ketayotganimiz haqidagi qarash.

examples.en: Help elderly people.
examples.uz: Keksa odamlarga yordam bering.

examples.en: Elderly residents were the last to be told.
examples.uz: Keksa aholiga eng oxirida aytildi.

examples.en: How can you justify the cost?
examples.uz: Xarajatni qanday oqlay olasiz?

examples.en: Nothing in the file justifies a decision of that size.
examples.uz: Jilddagi hech narsa bunday katta qarorni oqlamaydi.

examples.en: What's the status of my order?
examples.uz: Buyurtmamning holati qanday?

examples.en: The status of the project has been unclear since March.
examples.uz: Loyihaning holati martdan beri noaniq.

examples.en: There was a long debate about the new law.
examples.uz: Yangi qonun haqida uzoq munozara boʻldi.

examples.en: The debate ended with everyone holding exactly their original view.
examples.uz: Munozara hamma aynan oʻz dastlabki fikrida qolgan holda tugadi.

examples.en: He wrote a humorous story.
examples.uz: U hazil-mutoyibali hikoya yozdi.

examples.en: He made a humorous remark that nobody found funny.
examples.uz: U hazil aytdi, lekin uni hech kim kulgili deb topmadi.

examples.en: They built a new sports complex.
examples.uz: Ular yangi sport majmuasini qurishdi.

examples.en: The complex was built for two thousand people and houses four hundred.
examples.uz: Majmua ikki ming kishiga qurilgan va toʻrt yuz kishini sigʻdiradi.

examples.en: He stuffed the clothes into his bag.
examples.uz: U kiyimlarni sumkasiga tiqdi.

examples.en: The findings were stuffed into an appendix nobody opens.
examples.uz: Natijalar hech kim ochmaydigan ilovaga tiqib qoʻyilgandi.

examples.en: Do you have travel insurance?
examples.uz: Sayohat sugʻurtangiz bormi?

examples.en: The insurance covered everything except what actually happened.
examples.uz: Sugʻurta aslida yuz bergan narsadan boshqa hamma narsani qopladi.

examples.en: Uzbekistan borders Kazakhstan.
examples.uz: Oʻzbekiston Qozogʻiston bilan chegaradosh.

examples.en: The claim borders on the absurd and was accepted without question.
examples.uz: Daʼvo bemaʼnilikka yaqin va u soʻroqsiz qabul qilindi.

examples.en: It's just a routine check.
examples.uz: Bu shunchaki rejali tekshiruv.

examples.en: It was described as a routine check and lasted three days.
examples.uz: U rejali tekshiruv deb aytildi va uch kun davom etdi.

examples.en: Hurry up, otherwise we'll be late.
examples.uz: Shoshiling, aks holda kechikamiz.

examples.en: We need an answer by Friday; otherwise the offer lapses.
examples.uz: Bizga jumagacha javob kerak; aks holda taklif kuchini yoʻqotadi.

examples.en: What is the depth of the pool?
examples.uz: Basseynning chuqurligi qancha?

examples.en: Nobody had looked at the problem in any depth.
examples.uz: Muammoga hech kim chuqurroq qaramagandi.

examples.en: It takes years to master a language.
examples.uz: Tilni egallash uchun yillar kerak.

examples.en: It takes about ten years to master and about two to look competent.
examples.uz: Egallashga oʻn yilcha, malakali koʻrinishga esa ikki yil kerak.

examples.en: There's a fruit stand on the corner.
examples.uz: Burchakda meva rastasi bor.

examples.en: She took a stand that cost her a great deal.
examples.uz: U oʻziga juda qimmatga tushgan pozitsiyani egalladi.

examples.en: Material things don't make you happy.
examples.uz: Moddiy narsalar sizni baxtli qilmaydi.

examples.en: Nothing material has changed since the last review.
examples.uz: Oxirgi koʻrikdan beri moddiy jihatdan hech narsa oʻzgarmadi.
